scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT files is infeasible because the agent submits only the computed Seebeck values in CSV. The checker compares reported values to the paper-reported hidden gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Seebeck coefficients for GdNiSb and LuNiSb at 380 K from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract: GdNiSb 12.8 µV/K, LuNiSb 70 µV/K at 380 K
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper sentence 'Seebeck coefficients of both compounds are 12.8 and 70 µV/K at 380 K, resp.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported values; used as hidden gold for comparison.

outputs.description: Computed Seebeck coefficient at 380 K for the half-Heusler phases GdNiSb and LuNiSb.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's computed values to the hidden reference gold (paper-reported values) using a tolerance that allows for method-dependent spread.

steps.description: Verify Seebeck coefficients match paper-reported gold within tolerance and are positive.
